root_cause: The radios component only updates aria-expanded and conditional visibility on click events, not on keyboard-driven change events, causing conditionals to remain visible when focus moves via arrow keys.
repair_strategy: Add a change event listener to the radios module that invokes setAttributes on the changed radio when it has aria-controls, ensuring ARIA attributes and visibility are updated for keyboard interaction.
expected_accessibility_effect: Arrow key navigation between radios will correctly show/hide associated conditional fields, meeting WCAG 2.1.1 Keyboard and 2.4.3 Focus Order.
functional_risks: Both click and change events may fire for mouse interactions; setAttributes is idempotent so impact is minimal.
If other code relies on the ordering of change events, adding this listener could affect timing.
verification_requirements: Verify that selecting a radio via arrow keys updates aria-expanded and hides/shows the correct conditional field.
Verify that clicking a radio continues to work as before.
Ensure form values update correctly for both keyboard and mouse interaction.
Confirm no regression in existing click‑based behavior for other radios on the page.
